items.question: How should the lamp-residing deity be remembered during worship?
premises: The worshipper remembers the deity residing in the lamp.
The deity is endowed with youthful joy.
items.inference: Remembering the lamp-residing deity is part of the worship sequence.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action paired with remembering is not stated.
items.plain_english: Remembering the youthful, joy-endowed deity residing in the lamp.

items.question: Until when should this worship be performed, O Ambika?
premises: Worship is performed in this manner.
It continues until the Krishna fourteenth.
items.inference: The prescribed worship extends to the Krishna fourteenth.
uncertainties: Whether the endpoint is inclusive is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Thus one should worship until the Krishna fourteenth, O Ambika.

items.question: What result follows when this is done, O Kuleshani?
premises: This is done in the prescribed manner.
items.inference: Proper performance brings pleasure to the deity.
uncertainties: Whether pleasure extends to the worshipper is not stated.
items.plain_english: Thus, when done, O Kuleshani, the deity obtains pleasure.

items.question: How may the honored one wander after this?
premises: He is honored by all worlds.
He may wander as is comfortable.
items.inference: The honored practitioner may wander freely and comfortably.
uncertainties: The scope of wandering is not specified.
items.plain_english: Honored by all worlds, he may wander as he pleases.

items.question: Over what durations is this practice repeated?
premises: The practice is done in this manner.
It spans thirty-two days and sixty-four days.
items.inference: The practice is repeated across thirty-two-day and sixty-four-day periods.
uncertainties: Whether both durations are alternatives or sequential is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Thus in thirty-two days and in sixty-four days.

items.question: Who may perform this sequence himself?
premises: One who knows the sequence may do it himself.
items.inference: A sequence-knower free from wealth-deceit may perform it himself.
uncertainties: Whether additional qualifications are required is not stated.
items.plain_english: If one knows the sequence, he should do it himself, avoiding deceit about wealth.
